proof_body:
by
  intro V _ G _ a b k hk hb hr
  classical
  refine SimpleGraph.exists_isPerfectMatching_of_forall_ncard_le hb fun s => ?_
  have hN : (⋃ x ∈ s, G.neighborSet x) = ((s.toFinset.biUnion (fun x => G.neighborFinset x) : Finset V) : Set V) := by
    ext y
    simp
  rw [hN, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  set S := s.toFinset
  set T := S.biUnion (fun x => G.neighborFinset x)
  have hm : ∀ x ∈ S, k ≤ (Finset.bipartiteAbove G.Adj T x).card := by
    intro x hx
    have : G.neighborFinset x ⊆ Finset.bipartiteAbove G.Adj T x := by
      intro y hy
      rw [Finset.mem_bipartiteAbove]
      exact ⟨Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, hx, hy⟩, (G.mem_neighborFinset x y).mp hy⟩
    have h2 := Finset.card_le_card this
    rwa [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hr.degree_eq] at h2
  have hn : ∀ y ∈ T, (Finset.bipartiteBelow G.Adj S y).card ≤ k := by
    intro y _
    have : Finset.bipartiteBelow G.Adj S y ⊆ G.neighborFinset y := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Finset.mem_bipartiteBelow] at hx
      exact (G.mem_neighborFinset y x).mpr hx.2.symm
    have h2 := Finset.card_le_card this
    rwa [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hr.degree_eq] at h2
  have := Finset.card_mul_le_card_mul G.Adj hm hn
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_right this hk
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (a b : Set V) (k : ℕ), 0 < k → G.IsBipartiteWith a b → G.IsRegularOfDegree k → ∃ M : G.Subgraph, M.IsPerfectMatching
